title: Rudi Blesh, Johnny Stein and New York's slow acceptance of jazz
summary: Comments on books and interviews, ragtime as the earlier name, and New York's slowness to accept jazz.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press
